insights.title: Context grew from 34.1k to 180.4k tokens
insights.detail: The median context of the last three model calls (180.4k) is over 2× the median of the first three (34.1k); ~1.7M cumulative excess input-class tokens were re-paid beyond the opening baseline, at the rates those calls actually paid (cache reads where the context was served from cache). The estimate is an upper bound: it assumes the work could have continued from a compacted context. The largest tool outputs listed in evidence are the likely culprits.
